Permaculture is also sometimes referred to as “permanent agriculture”, as it emphasizes the development of agricultural systems which are adapted to local climatic and edaphic conditions, and which maintain their productivity over many generations without the inputs of external energy and resources.  Permaculture principles and practices are applied in many diverse contexts, including urban sites, village communities, and rural agricultural settings.
